environment.description: IoT message ingestion service running on EC2 (m5.large) behind an Application Load Balancer with no request filtering. The ALB forwards all POST requests on port 443 directly to the origin on port 8080. Security groups allow inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443 via the ALB. No rate limiting configured. Health check path is /health. The service processes messages from any client that can reach the ALB endpoint.

config.network: ALB -> target group port 8080, public subnet
